about: Commits allowed to reach a protected branch (main/master) without a PR, for PUBLIC repos only. Read by main-watch (CI), the global git pre-push hook, and the Claude Code push guard.  A rule matches when the commit subject matches `subject` (Python regex), the branch matches `branch` (if set), every changed file matches `paths` (if set), and no changed file matches `not_paths` (if set). No rule ever passes a commit that touches .github/** (enforced in code, whatever a rule says). Keep rules narrow: subject AND exact paths wherever the automation's file set is known. A private repo is never named here, not even by a hash: its rules live in its own .github/main-allowlist.json (read by main-watch) and in ~/.config/ci-policy/private-allowlist.json on the machines that push to it (read by the git hooks).
